business_problem: Horizon needed to simplify physician documentation in behavioral health so providers could spend less time on administrative tasks in the EHR and more time on patient treatment and connection.
solution_summary: Horizon Corporations rolled out Oracle Health AI Agents through its mobile physician workflows to automate behavioral-health documentation. The mobile application captures encounter details during care and generates a draft clinical note that providers can review, approve, and sign without typing the entire record manually. By putting the ambient documentation layer directly on providers' devices, Horizon can reduce note-writing time without asking clinicians to leave their normal patient interactions or sacrifice documentation quality. The AI agent also reduces the amount of time clinicians spend inside the EHR per patient, which matters in a treatment setting where provider attention and empathy are central to care delivery. The deployment shows how Oracle's clinical AI can be adapted to outpatient mental health and substance-use treatment workflows, where fast documentation turnaround directly affects staff burnout and the amount of time clinicians can devote to patients.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health AI Agents
solution_components.role: Generates draft clinical documentation from provider activity on mobile devices so physicians can complete notes faster.

data_flow: During patient encounters, Oracle Health AI Agents captures clinical details through the provider mobile workflow, drafts a note for physician review and sign-off, and shortens the time clinicians must spend documenting each visit in the EHR.
business_outcome: Horizon cut documentation and EHR time per patient, giving behavioral health providers more time to focus on treatment and patient connection while reducing burnout pressure.
